item.title: A train experience based on guilts
item.description: Can you really move on from the past?
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Page Layout (Optional): Standard template, but with an extra "Experiments" section beneath the description

Elevator Pitch: The train is built to exploit the guilts of the beings that enters the train. As such, the beings must be capable of thoughts and feelings. It's like a personal "hell loop" for subjects except you only get a chance in "relieving yourself of the guilt".

Central Narrative: It is the first in a series of human experiments conducted to determine and understand the nature of the human beings of Earth. The experiment(s) tests the ability to overcome guilt and/or let things go. Future SCPs (experiments) could be to test for other traits such as insecurities and selfishness.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Hopefully, the SCP will be followed by tales which introduces a group of mysterious beings and further expand on the diversity of the universes.

Additional Notes: I started on the drafts before realizing I had to green-light the idea and not the SCP document itself

item.title: An Exelent Dentist
item.description: Greenlight? An Anomalous dentist who uses patients teeth as a womb for its eggs.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article,

Genre: Horror/Psychological/Humour

Elevator Pitch:
The story revolves around an Ontario police department detective who discovers a string of disappearances leading him to a supernatural encounter and eventually recruitment into the SCP.

The SCP appears as a normal Dentist, family man, well respected and successful.

Central Narrative:

The SCP in this article is both setting and a lead in to another story I have in mind. The central horror narrative will be within the debriefing log of the Detective character of the story. The SCP itself will be a combination of light and creepy.

The SCP is intended to be Benign with a twist in further tales but for this story will be the creation point of the Detectives Horror story.

The Detective is an single minded workaholic with a talent for pattern recognition. He has been very successful the last few years professionally but at a great cost to his personal life which is now nonexistent. His mental state is also fraying due to overwork and PTSD.

His story begins after a medically induced coma and short term amnestics is administered to temporarily block memories which are harmful to the detective.

The Detective is being debriefed by an SCP Psychologist. Over the course of the debrief the Detectives memories will be challenged and teased out as the Amnestics wear off allowing him to gradually confront the horror of the SCP's progeny erupting from a persons teeth.

Hook/Attention-Grabber:
First off. I have a reoccurring nightmare about my teeth crumbling and being forced to spit out the pieces. I have talked to many people who have a similar dream and the internet says it is a pretty common one. This scares the fuck out of me and I bet it does a lot of people. But that is the cheap scares part.

Ideally I want the debrief to play like a slow reveal of the psychological degradation of the detective as he confronts his emerging memories of the events. Leading up to the death of someone he knew and purposefully led to the dentist in an effort to catch the SCP abducting the victim.

Additional Notes:

It's been a few year since I put pen to paper and I am looking forward to seeing if this idea is any good. I got super excited so this is actually already in second draft on my side. Thank you in advance for any commentary.

The Snow is Deep

item.title: SCP- Assimilator
item.description: Seeking greenlight for my concept.
item.content:encoded:
Item name: Assimilator

Greenlight: yes

Page layout: SCP article

Elevator pitch: A humanoid, resembling a male human, consisting of cells with anomalous biological characteristics, such as:

  • No presence of senescence.
  • Can modify their characteristics to provide enhanced regenerative abilities, and inhuman bursts of energy.
  • Immunity to all pathogens.

This SCP has been previously caught and studied, however it escaped Foundation custody and is now uncontained.

Central Narrative:
The cost of these properties is that the SCP needs more sustenance than a normal human. So, the entity finds it by eating food or hunting for live prey and/or carcasses to scavenge.

To hunt, it becomes a wraith-like mass consisting of mostly its cells to move like a swarm. Once in contact with prey, the mass encompasses it and begins stripping organic matter and nutrients from the organism, leaving only a husk. Once sated it returns to its normal form.

If the SCP gets severely injured, it will regenerate rapidly, however it will now need lots of energy replenishment, so it will consume large amounts of food or assimilate any living thing in its vicinity until sated.

The SCP can also shape shift into any creature by obtaining a sample of said creature’s DNA.

Hook/Attention:
The SCP creates backups for itself, in case it is destroyed, by infecting other creatures with its cells. The cells can also operate as a separate entity from the main body, which seeks out potential hosts.
Hosts fall into 3 categories:

"DORMANT": Cells lay low in the body, mimicking the host's cells to avoid an immune response and detection. Some become neurons to access the hosts memories and senses, and relays the information telepathically to the entity.

"ACTIVE": Upon the entity's order, cell replication rate increases and the cells take over the host, who is now under the control of the entity. The host is semi-sentient. This host will also mutate if severely damaged.

"REVIVAL": When sensing its destruction is imminent or when destroyed, the SCP’s cells in a particular host will begin replicating rapidly to replace the host with the entity. The reborn entity will retain all the memories of its previous body as well as the host's memories and skills.

The entity can also initiate rapid cellular degradation at will in itself to escape and revive in a host, or in an "ACTIVE" host to destroy it.

Hosts of SCP’s cells who are suffering from any disease or disorder, regardless of severity, will make a full recovery within 48 hours, assumed to be a by-product of the entity requiring a healthy host.

item.title: Want to earn Greenlighting Privileges and/or choose next month's front-page features?
item.description: Sign up for a Butterfly Flight! (February 2021 Flight) [OPEN COMMANDER SIGNUPS THIS MONTH!]
item.content:encoded:
Due to the ever-increasing demand for more skilled reviewers to help out in the forums, the Forum Criticism Staff Team has been holding 2-week mentoring sessions to train up-and-coming reviewers. These are called "Flights".1

What does being part of a Flight mean?

  • Flight 1 will run from February 1 to February 15. Flight 2 will run from February 15 to February 30.
  • Mentors (dubbed "commanders") will work with mentees ("officers") in the Writing Help forums to critique concepts and drafts while the officers practice and improve their critique skills.
  • At the start of the Flight, officers will determine their weekly goals for two categories: activity and quality. Activity can be something simple like "crit at least one thread a day", quality something like "be more familiar with matching authors to helpful resources/guides/example articles". Commanders will discuss these goals weekly.
  • Officers will be taught some forum management skills like how to respond (without backseat modding) to a thread that breaks guidelines.
  • If the officers cannot yet greenlight, they may officially recommend concepts to their commander for greenlight consideration.
  • Flight teams can have funny/rule of cool names. Commander discretion.

Who are the commanders this month?

The commanders for Flight 1 are Karablue9482 and TBA.

The commanders for Flight 2 are TBA.

Notice: for February, we are opening up commander signups to all individuals who currently have greenlighting privileges! If you're interested in learning about being a commander/mentor, please look at this page for more information.

Who can request consideration to be an officer?

Anyone! Newbies and veterans alike are welcome to put their names forth.

What do Flight participants get at the end?

  • For as long as the mentorship system continues, Flight teams will select the featured SCP, tale, and GoI format displayed on the front page of the site. Flight team member names will also be displayed on the front page of the site.2
  • Officers deemed ready by their commanders will be given greenlighting privileges (if they do not have them already), and their names and number of successful Flights will be displayed on the Butterfly Squad Roster.
  • Flight team member names will be displayed on the corresponding month's Site News page. Officers may optionally provide "flight signoff" messages where they briefly describe the experience and any parting words for future reviewer mentees.
  • (remember, provision of the rewards is up to commander discretion!)
Footnotes
1. Prepare for some Rule of Cool terminology, folks.
2. To accommodate six teams, the number of monthly front page features will be doubled.

item.title: JANUARY 2021 INTROS - Readers & Reviewers
item.description: Have you joined the site because you're an avid reader and are planning to vote, comment, or just lurk on the site? Interested in helping develop the Next Best Thing? Post your introduction here!
item.content:encoded:
Note: If you're going to introduce yourself here, please scroll down and click "New Post" and NOT "reply", otherwise your comment will nest incorrectly!

Hello, readers and reviewers of the Foundation Universe!

This month's random question is: what do you think is the best kind of food to eat with friends?

Let's start off with some things to take a look at to enhance your reading, now that you're a site member:

  • If you have any questions about the Foundation'verse and its various individuals and groups of interest, head over to the Foundation Universe forum to talk about the various aspects of living/working/being in constant fear of a world where anomalies are real.
  • Did you know our site has a night mode version? If you're interested in that (and a few other neat things!), check out our Usertools page.
  • Want to leave a comment or read others' thoughts on something you've read recently? Scroll down to the bottom of that page you read, click the "Discuss" link, and take a look at the comments others have posted!

For those looking to put your knowledge of the SCP-verse to work and contribute to the site by helping develop works-in-progress, head on over to the Writing Help forums!

  • So you want to be a concept reviewer?
  • So you want to be a draft reviewer?
  • And of course, remember the Criticism Policy!

If you're not sure what to talk about here, you can take a look at our How to Write an Intro/Welcome thread for ideas.

Go ahead and respond to other new members if you find that your interests overlap, and definitely ask for reading suggestions if there's a particular kind of SCP article or tale you enjoy reading. If you're looking to get started as a critiquer, feel free to mention the kind of material you particularly want to see more of on the wiki! You might even see some of our authors drop by here from time to time, if you mention you liked their work! :)

Welcome to the site!

item.title: New SCP idea in need of greenlighting
item.description: So I decided to try writing an SCP article
item.content:encoded:
So I decided to try writing an SCP article. Btw, I already have a draft written on the SCP sandbox site but the idea needs to be greenlighted first, so here you go!

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up extra space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) and titles short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Horror/Mystery

Page Layout (Optional): Standard layout with the new ACS + incident reports, interview logs, recovery log, etc.

Elevator Pitch: Short pitch: It's a sentient toy troll that can move and talk that carries a mycotoxin that, when inhaled, makes the subject turn into a mindless zombie covered in hair. The mindless zombie covered in hair will attempt to hug any human close to it, which will spread the infection.

+ show block
– hide block

Longer pitch

This SCP is a Euclid class anomaly. It is a sentient toy resembling Fuzzbert, a character from the Trolls movie. It is capable of movement and speech, although its speech has to be translated using an unknown device. When it is disturbed or feels endangered it lets out a mycotoxin (SCP-XXXX-1) that, when inhaled by a human or any other living organism in the class Mammalia, attacks the brain causing growth hormone modifications, which results in accelerated hair growth starting from the subjects head and ending around its pelvic region. Hair growth can also be seen from the subject's eyes, nostrils, ears, mouth, and below the fingernails. After a certain amount of time, the subjects (now referred to as SCP-XXXX-2) cognitive functions will become limited and it will attempt to hug any human it comes in contact with, which will result in the infection spreading to that person. SCP-XXXX-2 instances mainly show interest in humans, but other living organisms in the class Mammalia that come in contact with it will develop the same symptoms.

Central Narrative: On January 8. 2009. a boy was playing near an old Russian nuclear power plant when he found a weird toy that started walking towards him making weird gurgling noises. The boy got very curious and decided to pick the toy up. The toy started shaking and let out a cloud of green mist. The boy got scared and ran home, taking the toy with him. After a few minutes, he started having flu-like symptoms, with tingling sensations around his nose. He started growing massive amounts of hair around his body and started attacking his own mother. Obviously scared, she called the police. The police arrived shortly after and found a creature covered in hair trying to break into a room. They neutralized the creature and contacted the SCP Foundation shortly after. When the Foundation arrived, they found a small toy that was walking around the house. They figured that that toy was the cause of the incident. They immediately sedated it and transported it to Site-██, where it currently resides. It was classified as a Euclid level SCP and given the number XXXX.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: I feel like this SCP is a mix of multiple other existing SCPs but still has originality. It is interesting how mysterious its origin is, no one currently knows how it came to be or why it infects people, or how it can communicate with other people, or why instances of SCP-XXXX-2 are only interested in humans but can infect other animals as well. But those questions might be answered in the future… I also feel like the symptoms of the infection are pretty interesting, with all the hair growth and trying to hug people.

Additional Notes: So I already made a sandbox article, but I still think it needs some working to be done on it. Also, I was thinking of slowly answering all the questions about the SCP through interview logs and stuff, and also doing some SCP cross-links if you're ok with it. I will post the draft link here if you want.


Author, please note the Ideas Critique required reading wordcount limit; your post is about 160 words over. Please address this before seeking further feedback. ~Zyn

item.title: New SCP Idea
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Page Layout (Optional): Containment procedures, description, an addendum or two, and 2 ethics committee reports

Elevator Pitch: A man with severely burned skin who claims to have gone to the Christian hell. His skin will anomalously smolder and catch on fire at random intervals.

Central Narrative: One day, a man drenched in fire ran out of a burning building. It took a while to put him out and calm him down, but it was a mystery as to how he survived. The Foundation was alerted when his burns refused to heal and even got hotter, sometimes causing fires.

The man claimed to be Junior Toure, an Angolan man who died 67 years before he was found by The Foundation. His skin stayed burned and caught on fire randomly, but that was easily dealt with in the form of automatic sprinklers.

The man claimed to have gone to what he believed to be the Christian interpretation of hell, claiming to have seen glimpses of an endless field with people laying on the ground, bound by chains, forever on fire, the flames growing ever hotter.

He was in constant pain. He cried regularly and screams could be heard from his cell for hours on end. There was no way to help him. Eventually, a grievance with the ethics committee was filed, asking them if he should be put out of his misery. After an interview, he said "I don't want that. I don't want to return."

+ show block
– hide block

Toure aged normally, and as he did, his mental state deteriorated. He became paranoid and erratic, fearing death and a return to that hellish place. He died insane, with the only resemblance of peace being him requesting that his body be put in the ocean, saying "It might dull the pain while I'm down there."

His body burned nonstop after he died, with nothing being able to stop it. It eventually turned into a pile of ash. Another ethics committee grievance was filed, asking for Toure's last wish to be granted. The committee stipulated that if the ash had no anomalous properties, then it was to be dispersed in the Pacific Ocean.

The ash was found to be non-anomalous, and the dead man's wish was fulfilled. His ashes found their way to the bottom of the ocean, bearing a stark contrast to what he was bound to for eternity to come.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: It's a very dark SCP, which is nothing new, but it would also be a neutralized SCP.

Additional Notes:

item.title: User05
item.description: A strange man on Discord who slowly makes his way into a person's life.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Horror

Page Layout: ACS Header, basic layout, etc.

Elevator Pitch: A user on Discord that causes a person's existence to vanish

Central Narrative: The person in question is called "User05" on Discord, and the exact name + tag is censored. The only way to come into contact with the user is pure luck. He'll usually send a friend request (which should not be accepted).

When a person starts talking to User05, he'll seem normal at first, seemingly like he used to know them or they used to be friends. After about ten (10) minutes of talking, stuff starts getting weird.

  • Vagueness
  • Familiar pictures of the persons life
  • Misspelling
  • Faster typing
  • Spamming random letters
+ show block
– hide block

The victim might not see anything odd about it, just a casual troll on Discord. However, things get even stranger when he states the full legal name of the victim, age, and physical appearances. He sends pictures of the victim's face in various angles in random areas, as though he never knew he was being pictured. After this event, User05 goes silent for around 3-5 days.

After he returns, he claims that he knows where he lives, who he lives with, and will arrive there shortly. The first way of contact is through mail, which is a piece of paper that says "Hi. :) - Me"
If the victim continues to talk to the man on Discord, the SCP will speak in an unknown language, send pictures resembling satanism practices, etc.

  • Unknown language
  • Pictures of satanism
  • Spamming of the phrase "C0N9V3RT", followed by random symbols
  • Spam calls
  • Discord crashing

The victim will feel the sudden urge to block or unfriend the SCP after Discord crashes, and the urge can not be stopped no matter how much the victim denies it.

Blocking the SCP, or unfriending the SCP will just make things worse. If a victim does so, they will hear knocking on their front door directly after they unfriend/block User05. Their computer will crash, and all the doors in the house will lock (even if they don't have a lock on it). After the knocking stops, the door will open, and footsteps can be noticeable at this point, and get louder by the second, and faster, to the point where he's practically running. The footsteps stop at the bedroom door, but the door doesn't open. The light in the room will either explode or turn off, and the fan will turn on if it's off, or off it's it on. After the lights go out, the victim loses consciousness, and disappear out of everyone's life. However, after he goes missing, no trace of him will be left behind (SSN, birth certificate, any licenses, any proof of existence) as he just never existed in the first place. No missing posters, no sobbing relatives, nothing, he never existed.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: A cool anomaly that sort of follows the generic paranormal scheme, but it's detection is almost impossible as the victim's existence vanishes and no one knows who he is (as the people who do, don't exist).


As a courtesy to our readers on mobile devices, please collapse long posts. Also, please note the Ideas Critique required reading wordcount limit; your post is about 75 words over. Please address this before seeking further feedback. ~Zyn

item.title: SCP-XXXX My friend ED (Seeking Greenlight)
item.description: The mind is a delicate thing
item.content:encoded:
The mind is a delicate thing, and when your life starts to take a turn for the worse and an SCP seems to be watching your every move, it might just break.

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up extra space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) and titles short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP article

Genre: Horror

Page Layout: A standard SCP file with a focus on a journal where the afflicted documented their experience with the SCP, contrasted with interview logs and reports from coworkers documenting their perspective on the afflicted's slow decent.

Elevator Pitch: Researcher exposes self to SCP-XXXX, a standard horrific monster. It doesn't seem like the SCP even notices her, until she starts to see it every time something goes wrong.

Central Narrative: The central narrative is a documentation of the Doctor's slow decent into 'madness.' As more and more things go wrong in her life, she ends up doing several self destructive things and perpetuating the cycle. All the while she sees this SCP every time something goes wrong. Everything from accidentally telling the person serving lunch to enjoy their food too to a fatal car crash that takes the lives of one of her coworkers.

+ show block
– hide block

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The main thing that I'm hoping to make different is to cause the reader to question the reality of what this researcher is experiencing. The whole point of the story is to cause the reader to wonder "Is the SCP causing this, or is it just there when it happens? Or is the SCP even there at all?"

Additional Notes: I know that the theme of questioning reality due to an SCP isn't exactly a new one, which is why I'm hesitant to even post this. But I have yet to see a concept similar to this so I was hoping that maybe there's still a market for a monster that just fucks with your mind. Or perhaps doesn't. Who really knows.


As a courtesy to our readers on mobile devices, please collapse long posts. ~Zyn

item.description: Um, hey, I'm looking for a greenlight. Can somebody crit or greenlight?
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes.

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Horror

Elevator Pitch: A devoid of facial features, humanoid-entity, gets confused by others as a Wight. However, it is not. This humanoid entity decreased the body temperature of an individual down to -5000°C that gets in contact within the range of a 20-meter circular area and can create snowstorms at the temperature of -5000°C also.

Central Narrative:

+ show block
– hide block

The Foundation acquired this anomaly when a group of tourists in Da Lat1 was found death and their body temperature seems to be below 0°C, as a witness claims that the only person who wasn't dead among all of the tourists was an individual wearing a black hoodie covering their entire face. As MTF-Gormity-10, "Ground Controllers" were deployed to detained the anomaly. However, several attempts resulted in failures until they've finally figured out its anomalous effects and successfully detained it in the next attempt due to not understanding its anomalous properties. Which after they've found out it is capable of speech.

The anomaly was designated as SCP-XXXX and classified to be a Keter Class anomaly. Based on the Foundation's logs, SCP-XXXX appears to have powerful latent thermal, cryokinesis, and snowstorm manipulation abilities that happen naturally. In one of the incidents, SCP-XXXX's anomalous properties accidentally produced a powerful energy force that almost frozen the entire facility and almost resulted in some SCPs and personnel being killed as the Foundation decides that SCP-XXXX will be detained in a standard humanoid containment chamber constructed out of tungsten and is furnished with in-organic furniture and two large heating devices that're at the temperature of 700°C, combining with the -5000°C of SCP-XXXX will not result in any problems, any personnel who enters its containment chamber won't feel too hot nor too cold due to the temperature being stable thanks to both of the heating devices and the freezing abilities of SCP-XXXX.

In some of the addendums, the Foundation has stated that SCP-XXXX's future experiments are performed in a special room separated far away from the Site. In SCP-XXXX experiments, it is shown that SCP-XXXX was observed to have high durability, intelligence in manipulating others, agility, and skill at weapon masteries, especially silhouette knives as it uses as long-range attacking weapons and also close-range attacking weapons. SCP-XXXX states that it has no clue of how it was able to do so.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: An anomaly that freezes peoples to death within the range of a circular 20-meters.

item.content:encoded:

Genre: Drama

Page Layout: Standard containment procedures, description, discovery, testing logs and containment report.

Elevator Pitch: A sculpture of "The Three Graces" that spreads an memetic infection of emotional empathy. It was commissioned from an anartist for the Manna Charitable Foundation as an attempt to increase charitable acts. In particular, acts that include helping people normally considered of a lower class or importance. This extends to trying to protect these individuals from harm.

Any close viewing of charitable acts caused by the infection further spreads it to the viewer. The effect can also be spread through images and videos. This allows online spread of the memetic effect though literal viral posts and stories.

Central Narrative: Sites near [liberal city] experiences difficulty treating D-class as disposable and accepting collateral loss of life. An investigation looks into the situation and also finds increased charity efforts and the near elimination of homelessness in a large portion of the country. Further investigation discovers the infection. Originating from the sculpture newly installed in the city's downtown area.

The foundation confiscates the statue and tests antimemes for internal use. The site regains the ability to find D-Class suffering and death acceptable via the antimemetics. Using online bots they deploy these antimemes within disparaging and skeptical comments on the viral posts. Nearly all posts are effected and debased as either attention seeking or faked. This extents into offline instances being 'inoculated' by onlookers heckling and mocking the charitable acts.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Exploring the idea that the foundation works beyond compassion. Thus cannot exist in a world that is dedicated to it.

Additional Notes: I'm playing with the idea that the foundation is worried the viral posts could become resistant. Thus they are forced to worry not if they are too immoral, but too moral in their acts.

item.title: New SCP: Book of irreligious obsession
item.description: causes religious readers to abandon their faith, and and redirect that energy
item.content:encoded:
A book titled “The Figments of the Mind” by Mark Desoreau causes religious readers to abandon their faith, and and redirect that energy towards a harmless hobby, growing obnoxious and violent as they obsess with it.

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up extra space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) and titles short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

Howdy folks, new here, though I remember when 173 was just an /x/ post. I've always wanted to write an SCP but never had any good ideas, until one struck me a couple weeks ago. It's ready to post, but I'm here for Greenlight first - I hope I'm following all the correct protocols!

As the summary says, it's a seemingly innocuous text - the first instance discovered was titled “The Figments of the Mind” by Mark Desoreau - which appears to be a fairly basic work of the pro-reason/anti-superstition genre - but when read by anyone of deep religious convictions, it causes them to gradually abandon their religion, and then take up a new hobby to replace it. UFOs, online gaming, RPG universes - first they abandon work and alienate their friends and family, then (in 70% of suspected cases in the wild) they eventually become violent.

Futhermore, it appears that this text keeps cropping up throughout history, with an Ur copy in the 15th century, although a possible precursor is mentioned by Tacitus in describing Nero.

The whole thing is a meta-critique on how people can go crazy forming cults out of the weirdest things, and while they might not seem dangerous at first, at the minimum it can lead to disastrous life outcomes, dragging their friends and family down.

I've done what I can to embed it in the universe (the first Alpha instance was a guy obsessed with SCP-1425 Star Signals, but who'd never read that book - it turns out that was just his 'hobby obsession'). I definitely wouldn't mind some critiques from the more detail-oriented people in improving my cross-SCP references.

I hope you like the idea - tell me if/when you want it in Sandbox.

item.title: SCP Idea: A Motel With An Elevator
item.description: A motel with an elevator? Weird, but It's definitely just there for show, right...right?
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Page Layout: Standard layout + Incident/exploration/interview logs

Elevator Pitch: The SCP is an elevator behind a motel that can take you to pocket dimensions with doors that have weird stuff behind them

Genre: Horror and a little bit of comedy and emotion.

+ show block
– hide block

Central Narrative: In 2010, The manager of Moonlight Shores went to the back of the motel to have a quick smoke break. While he was smoking, he noticed an elevator near him. He never noticed there was an elevator because he would always smoke at the back of the motel, so he entered the elevator out of curiosity and saw that there are only six numbered buttons on the panel. He pressed on one of the buttons, and the elevator took him to a hallway full of rooms. He tried to open one of the doors but failed because it was locked. He tried using his management key to open it but failed again. As a last resort, he looked through the keyhole to see what was inside. after seeing what was inside, he started to panic and quickly ran back inside the elevator returning to our world. He then called the police and told them he saw a room that had eyeballs for walls and saw ordinary objects wrapped in human flesh. After investigation, the police contacted the Foundation, and then the Foundation purchased the property for testing.

D-personnel will be asked to open a few doors and video-tape what they see or find along the way.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Each door has something special. One door could lead to a parallel-universe of earth, but it was taken over by an unknown species of animals. One door could lead you into a room that looks luxurious, but if you stay in there long enough. Its looks fade away and you're left with a room that looks abandoned. One door can be just a room filled with clown paintings, and those paintings can make the person that looks at them laugh to death (literally). Who knows!

Additional Notes: Since all the doors are locked. I was thinking about using SCP-005 to help open the doors. I know people don't like the idea of older SCP cross-linking to the newer ones, so If you guys don't like the idea of these two SCPs cross-linking, I'll leave it alone.

Not all the doors are gonna lead you into a room or if it does, it won't always be a room filled with some monstrosity every time. just wanted to let you guys know, so you won't get confused.

item.title: Idea for Greenlight - Russian Nesting Souls
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Page Layout (Optional): Standard layout + Incident/testing/interview logs

Elevator Pitch:
SCP-XXXX is a Russian nesting doll consisting of 3 layers. Upon opening the innermost doll; the object will activate. Upon activation, the 5 meter radius around the doll will be filled with a bright piercing light of no discernible origin for about 30 seconds. During this time, all individuals in area aside from the object's activator (henceforth SCP-XXXX-1) will immediately be vaporized. SCP-XXXX-1 will find themselves transfigured into one the now missing individuals, both in look and voice. The doll will now be embedded in the center of their chest with the front side protruding. Doll will now depict separate individual who was vaporized. Upon death or attempted removal of doll (which will cause instant heart failure), XXXX-1 will transfigure into individual depicted on doll, and the doll will change to depict a new individual. The entity will then come back to life. This process continues until all iterations have been cycled through and the entity will return to their original body; with the doll now depicting it's original marking. Any death or attempted removal after this point will result in permanent death at which object will dislodge itself. The object can speak telepathically to XXXX-1 and does so in a motherly Russian voice.

Central Narrative:
Through logs, the article will detail an incident during initial testing in which a D-class activated the object, resulting in the absorption of 2 researchers, an agent, a janitor, and another D-class. Further testing of object will be detailed as well as interviews with object will be noted. Ultimately, site directors decide object is safer contained in vessel as re-activation would require vessel be killed multiple times. Most knowledge of object is candidly provided by object itself in interviews. Object appears to have been created as a tool of war.

Hook/Attention-Grabber:
I plan to weave a narrative of the D-class who has essentially became a living nesting doll, now with multiple "lives".

Additional Notes: I am aware of two other nesting doll SCP, so hopefully 3 isn't a crowd. The anomalous effects of the object should be fresh enough though.

item.title: SCP-5870
item.content:encoded:
Hello! Veralta's here with a new SCP about koalas, nature, the future of Australia, and intricate worldbuilding based on the beliefs of aboriginal Australian people like the Bundjalung and the Eora. Consider this SCP a free New Year trip through Australia, and a little bit of a crash course on the Australian condition.

Also, it's linked to Ralliston's Obearwatch Command; fun fact, all of these started when he threw the word "Koalalition" at me, and I said, "Hmm… uwah, this looks interesting". I initially planned out a short article with a gimmick and a punchline.

But then, I realized I had to dive deep into the waterhole.

The aboriginal Australian belief system, also called Dreamtime1, is very complex and interesting. It would be a shame if I just went with a silly punchline when aboriginal culture, with its mix of hopes and dreams for Australia, needs a chance to shine here.

Lastly, consider this article as a piece dedicated to Australians and wildlife - such as the koalas themselves - who have been affected by the severe bushfires. As a Filipino youth, I couldn't do much to be honest, aside from raising awareness. I tried to stay true to the myths' essence while adding my style of writing to them, while I researched news about the bushfires.

All in all, though, please enjoy this SCP, and I wish a Happy New Year - and more happy years - to come for all of us!

Special thanks to Ralliston2, Meisteroni, DrChandra, Rose the Changeling , for concept checking and making my narrative is solid. Dysadron and caspian2 also have my gratitude for their comprehensively good LBL and critique. Last but not the least, I also want to give a well-deserved shoutout to Dr Balthazaar for providing guidance on Australian beliefs and culture. You guys are amazing!

Footnotes
1. By the way, this word does not cover what the beliefs really mean, and while dreaming is a part of the culture, it is not just that. Additionally, the word "Dreamtime" may even be just a mistranslation of words meant for deities.
2. Bear goes rawr :p

item.title: Dark Dogs Ritual
item.description: A Dark Dog that is being summoned by a group of stray dogs and chases after them to feed.
item.content:encoded:
Greenlight: yes

Page layout: SCP article

Elevator pitch: Stray dogs goes into a forest to commence a ritual involving a black dog with the unidentifiable breed to have it fed. It only comes once three weeks; when that happens, the Dark dog will choose which dog to eat based on its bravery (fending off the creature). It will attack humans, will kill them but will not eat them.

+ Central Narrative
- Central Narrative

Central Narrative: Dr Fox observes them afore and tries to understand why these dogs are circling one particular spot, first time watching the dogs the research team had no idea about the three-week circle. So when the last day of the third week hits a giant dog appears and begins to chase the dogs around trying to find one that is stronger, all of the dogs dispersed its attacked spot where the researcher was and started to hunt them down. Dr Fox attempted to fend off the creature but was dragged under a car by three other dogs. Same with another researcher (they all hide) They hid under the car for 7 hours while the creature continues to hunt after dogs until it found one that began to bark at it, it ate the dog and disappeared back to the forest.

Later, Dr Fox wants to learn why one specific spot, so they dig the area and found skeletons of a man (named Damian) and a dog. Knowing this, they investigate the whole forest and learns that the bodies were murder victims. After extensive investigation, the lead points to his roommate. It said that Damian left his dorm to walk in the morning with his dog on 01/01/2014 and never returned. The roommate ends up being the one that killed Damian and the dog. While in containment, the stray dogs started to circle the site and caused containment breach, and the dark dog bites off Dr Fox’s hand (severely injuring her). And she learns that the dog and Damian’s skeletons when together were the ones that were manifesting the dark dog.

Hook/Attention: a little jab on the idea that dogs can sense evil spirits.
